environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with no WAF association. The ALB forwards all HTTP traffic directly to the Django application running on port 8000. No input validation middleware is configured. The application uses Django 4.2 with DRF 3.14, Python 3.11. The EC2 instance has an IAM role with S3 and SSM access for deployment purposes.

config.infrastructure: AWS EC2 t3.medium, ALB without WAF, no network ACL restrictions on payload content
config.network: VPC with public subnet, ALB listener on port 443 forwarding to target group on port 8000
